rationale: I read the complete held EO 11105 (28 FR 3909, Apr. 18, 1963): sec. 2 transfers specified Atomic Energy Community Act of 1955 functions from the AEC to the Housing and Home Finance Administrator (applicable to Los Alamos only, sec. 1), secs. 3-5 transfer property interests and funds, sec. 7 amends EO 9816, sec. 9 amends EO 10657 by adding a Los Alamos exclusion. It has no own sunset or condition term (the TERM records are funds-transfer wording, not endings). I read the complete held EO 12553 (51 FR 7237, Feb. 25, 1986, 'Revocation of Various Executive Orders'): the operative sentence orders that 'the following Executive Orders, and any amendments thereto, are revoked', and the table on 51 FR 7242 (PDF page 14) lists '11105 Transferring to the Housing and Home Finance Administrator certain functions of the Atomic Energy Commission under the Atomic Energy Community Act of 1955' by number and subject. The order has no exception, no savings clause and no sections after the table. The ACT record's names_target=false and 'via EO 10657' wording is a machine artifact of the two-column OCR layout; I confirmed the by-number listing in the held text itself, so the NO does not rest on the EO 10657 inference. D6 self-check: the history lists only the EO 12553 revocation events (the catalog line 'Revoked by: EO 12553' and the table line); I searched the held texts for 11105 and found no later order that amends, revives, extends or re-delegates EO 11105 (EO 14257 hits are tariff-code digits). Sec. 7 and sec. 9 amendments to EO 9816 and EO 10657 are effects of the order itself and fall with its revocation; I did not rely on EO 9816 or EO 10657 status for the NO. No earlier ending was found in the held record, and no earlier ending would change a 1986 whole-order revocation. Provisional NO hypothesis only.
